dedupe_keys.name: nanjing sponge city planning and construction guide 2018

description: The Nanjing Sponge City Planning and Construction Guide is a municipal technical guide that sets out how sponge city requirements are applied in planning, design and management in Nanjing, China, deepening the national and provincial norms and technical guides. It covers the whole administrative area of Nanjing and applies to new and rebuilt projects, with chapters on general principles, terms, planning and design targets, planning guidance, design guidance and management guidance, and appendices giving the relation between annual runoff volume control and design rainfall, control indicators for each regulatory planning unit, planning indicators by land use type (residential, commercial, public, industrial, transport, roads and parks) and recommended plants for rain gardens, green roofs, sunken green space and wetlands. It was compiled by the Nanjing Planning Bureau with the North China Municipal Engineering Design and Research Institute and issued by the city's sponge city leading group office in June 2018. It is available as a free PDF of 129 pages in Chinese on a Nanjing government website; no licence is stated. Caveats: it is local, advisory guidance from 2018. It supports parameterising sponge city and green-blue stormwater measures in drainage and climate adaptation models; a related record is the SuDS Manual.
